history.content: Hi Palak, nice to meet you! I’m Aanya from Northstar Homes. How can I help you today?

That’s a great choice. Northstar One in Sector 79, Gurugram has 2 BHK flats starting at ₹1.35 Crore onwards.

To help me guide you better, are you looking for this for your own home or as an investment?
own home , i want to check visit

That sounds perfect! A site visit is the best way to see the layouts and location for yourself.

What day and time would work best for you to visit Northstar One?

I’m sorry, but the 10:00 AM slot on September 7th isn’t available.

We do have these other times open:
*   September 6th at 10:00 AM or 4:00 PM
*   September 7th at 11:00 AM
*   September 8th at 3:00 PM
*   September 10th at 10:00 AM

Does any of those work for you?

Your site visit is confirmed for September 7th at 11:00 AM at Northstar One, Sector 79, Gurugram.

Someone from our team will call you a day before to confirm the details. We look forward to seeing you then!
Great! We’ll see you on September 7th at 11:00 AM. Have a wonderful day, Palak!
